name: Orascom Development Holding
source: Orascom Development Holding AG, consolidated statement of financial position at 31 December 2025 (audited, Deloitte AG), pages F-5 to F-6, statement date 31 December 2025. Currency CHF, absolute. FY2024 and FY2023 columns carried as the statement's own comparative figures and verified to match the values already stored in this file. FY2025 balance sheet totals are printed; the current / non-current split is the printed subtotal and is also confirmed by the identity Non-current + Current = Total on each side of the sheet.
note: Consolidated statement of financial position, CHF absolute units. Total current assets and total current liabilities include assets held for sale of 43416175 and liabilities directly associated with assets held for sale of 21132168 as printed by the issuer. Non-current plus current equals total on both sides, and assets equal liabilities plus equity, in both periods.
